newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian family confidence index falls in November.
newsitem.headline: Italian family confidence index falls in November.

text.p: Confidence among Italian households fell markedly in November with a deterioration in their expectations for employment over the next 12 months, economic research group Isco said.
Isco's confidence index fell to 102.7 (1980=100) in November from 106.0 in October and 110.9 in November 1995. It was the third successive month-on-month fall in the index.
Isco said its monthly survey also showed Italians expected prices to fall.

While it registered a slight improvement in expectations for the family's economic situation, it noted intentions to buy durable goods in the near future or a new car within the next two years had dwindled slightly, while expectations of house purchases were significantly lower.
